title: Range of a Cubic Polynomial
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: The function f(x)=x^3-x is a cubic polynomial. Find its range on the whole real line.

steps.title: Examine End Behavior
steps.explanation: The leading term x^3 dominates, so outputs grow without bound in the positive direction as x does, and without bound negatively as x decreases.
steps.why: Odd-degree polynomials with positive leading coefficient are unbounded in both directions.

steps.title: Note Continuity
steps.explanation: As a polynomial, f has no breaks or jumps anywhere.
steps.why: Polynomials are continuous on the entire real line.

steps.title: Apply the Intermediate Value Property
steps.explanation: Given any target value c, choose inputs a and b with f(a) < c < f(b); continuity forces some x between them to satisfy f(x)=c.
steps.why: A continuous function on an interval attains every value between its endpoint values.

steps.title: State the Range
steps.explanation: Every real number occurs as an output, so the range is the full line.
steps.why: Unboundedness in both directions plus continuity together cover all reals.
